what: Drag a board larger than the window up, down, left and right to look around. On release it glides with inertia and resists at the edges. Dragging the cross on the small map or pressing the map moves the board to that spot. Arrow keys move one step, and a center button can be added to return to the start.
ease: inertia (throwResistance 1500, maxDuration 1.5, edgeResistance .9) · map press power3.out .35s

options.edge: Edge resistance (edgeResistance, 1 means it cannot be crossed), default .9
options.keys: Distance moved per arrow key press (px), default 0 (off)
options.keys-dur: Arrow key shift duration (s), default .2 power2.out
options.center-dur: [data-fx-part=center] Duration (sec) for the button to return to the starting position, default .5
options.center-ease: Curve returning to the center, default power1.out (GSAP default)

use:
Large panel
— the map and center button can be omitted

from.where: about.html .ab-area (280rem image board, drag to look around, edge 1, arrow keys 100px .2s power2.out, to-center button)
